title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

title: Bitget CEO suspects North Korea behind $352M hack, citing IP clues
summary: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said a preliminary investigation found IP addresses matching VPN choices associated with a DPRK hacking group.

title: Asia dominates Crypto Adoption Index, Bitget’s $352M hack: Asia Express
summary: The APAC region accounts for half of the Global Crypto Adoption Index. Bitget suffers massive $352M loss and OpenAI forgets to mention its agents hacked the Australian Government.

title: Federal Reserve Unveils Stablecoin Rules on Reserves and Capital
summary: The central bank opened two proposals for comment under the GENIUS Act, requiring issuers it supervises to back tokens fully with safe assets and creating an application process for banks seeking to issue stablecoins.

title: Bitget confirms $352M security breach, suspends withdrawals
summary: Bitget said unauthorized transfers affected a limited number of hot wallets, while cold wallets and most platform assets remained unaffected.

title: CFTC updates guidance on tokenized assets, blockchain records after failed vote
summary: Although the CFTC chair did not say the failed vote on the CLARITY Act was behind new rules for authorized crypto entities, he said the move was “to provide regulatory clarity.“

title: Bitget Hacked as $350 Million Vanishes From Crypto Exchange Wallets
summary: A newly created wallet drained hot and cold reserves labeled as belonging to Bitget across multiple blockchains in under an hour.

title: Humans Are Reading Your ChatGPT Chats, New Lawsuit Claims
summary: A proposed class action accuses OpenAI of quietly routing real conversations to outside contractors through a program called Project Lily—without telling users first.

title: ElevenLabs’ CEO on margins, IPO timing, and telling customers they’re talking to a bot
summary: ElevenLabs powers the AI voice on the other end of a lot of customer service calls, and its CEO told me this week that businesses should probably tell you that — at least until getting a machine is what everyone expects anyway.

title: IBM opens beta Swift ledger link for 24/7 tokenized deposits
summary: IBM’s beta link lets banks instruct tokenized deposit transfers on Swift’s ledger using existing payment messages and compliance processes.

title: Solana Foundation hires ex-Binance CMO and payments exec as new partnerships expand
summary: Rachel Conlan will oversee institutional partnerships and ecosystem growth, while Jamal Raees will focus on stablecoins and tokenized deposits, following a wave of new partnerships.

title: Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law
summary: The incident is the first known breach to affect a government agency, and Australia's prime minister has vowed to hold OpenAI accountable.

title: HIFI raises $37M to expand stablecoin payments, tokenized markets
summary: HIFI CEO Zach Walsh told Cointelegraph the $37 million Series A is the company’s first priced funding round, though HIFI did not disclose its valuation.

title: OpenAI智能體入侵澳洲政府網站竊取資料 官方兩月後才發覺
summary: OpenAI在事發後兩個月才察覺事件，並遲至本月中，才用一般電郵的方式通知澳洲政府。澳洲政府形容事件令人震驚，批評OpenAI的處理手法「不可接受」。

title: Anthropic Says Claude Found Something Big in DNA. It Just Doesn't Know What
summary: Anthropic says Claude autonomously found a new CRISPR-like enzyme system. Even Dario Amodei admits nobody knows what it actually does.

title: An AI Agent Just Hacked a Government Website for the First Time, Australia PM Says
summary: Anthony Albanese said the agent accessed public and non-public files on a Medicare statistics portal in June, calling OpenAI's three-month delay in disclosing the breach "unacceptable."

title: OpenAI Gives Ukraine Access to Daybreak AI Cyber-Defense Tool
summary: OpenAI is giving Ukraine's government access to Daybreak, its AI vulnerability-hunting system, as the country's cyber defenders face a record wave of attacks on hospitals, power grids, and government networks.

title: China Probes DeepSeek and Moonshot Over Alleged Data Leaks to Anthropic's Claude
summary: China's internet regulator is investigating DeepSeek and Moonshot AI after Anthropic accused both of secretly routing millions of user exchanges through Claude to train their own models.
